job.title: Painter
job.description:
Painter - Commercial & Residential
  • Monday to Friday – 7:00am to 3:30pm
  • Open to ABN Applicants
  • Ongoing work across various projects
About the Client:
Our client is a well-established company delivering quality results on residential and commercial projects across Perth. With a strong pipeline of new builds, they are looking for experienced and reliable Painters to join their team.
This is a great opportunity for painters who take pride in their work, have a strong eye for detail and want consistent Monday to Friday work across a variety of projects.

About the role:
You’ll be responsible for all aspects of painting for residential and commercial new builds across Perth. You’ll work as part of a professional team, ensuring projects are completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
The day to day:· Prepare surfaces including sanding, filling, patching and cleaning· Apply paints, primers, sealers and other coatings to internal and external surfaces· Complete cutting-in, rolling and spraying where required· Paint walls, ceilings, doors, frames, trims and other surfaces· Complete preparation and finishing work to a high standard· Work at heights and from elevated work platforms when required· Maintain a clean and organised work area· Follow site safety requirements and construction procedures· Work efficiently to meet project deadlines and schedules

What’s in it for you?
· Monday to Friday - 7:00am to 3:30pm
· Consistent hours· Variety of residential and commercial new-build projects
· Ongoing work with an established company
· Work alongside experienced tradespeople
· Opportunity to secure long-term work for the right person

You’ll be a great fit if you are:
· Experienced in commercial or residential painting
· Confident completing all aspects of painting and surface preparation
· Quality-focused with a strong eye for detail
· Reliable, punctual and hard-working
· Able to work independently and as part of a team
· Safety-conscious and committed to following site procedures
· Comfortable working at heights
· Physically fit and capable of working on construction sites

You MUST have:
· Working at Heights qualification
· White Card
· Own reliable transport
· Relevant painting experience
· Elevated Work Platform (EWP) qualification/licence preferred

This is a hands-on role suited to a painter who takes pride in their work, works well within a team and is looking for reliable Monday to Friday hours.

What you need to do next…
If you're an experienced painter, have the required tickets and are ready for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

Click APPLY NOW! and tell us why you'd be a great fit for the team.
For further information please email Ethan at ethan@irp.net.au OR call on 0418 715 400.

IRP is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from women, and people of Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander descent.
